mapper.sql: fnd30_opr_id AS opr_id, fnd30_opr_cd AS opr_code, fnd30_demand_date AS demand_date, fnd30_item_nm AS item_name, fnd30_market AS market, fnd30_lead_manager AS lead_manager, fnd30_demand_period AS demand_period, fnd30_price_bracket AS price_bracket, fnd30_price AS price, COALESCE(fnd30_price_accept_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS price_accept_yn, CASE WHEN fnd30_price_accept_yn = 'true' THEN '예' ELSE '아니요' END AS price_accept_str, fnd30_lock_period AS lock_period, fnd30_appr_id AS appr_id, apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code, f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, fnd30_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name, COALESCE(fnd30_cancel_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS cancel_yn, CASE WHEN COALESCE(fnd30_cancel_yn, 'false') = 'true' THEN '√' ELSE '' END AS cancel_name, fnd30_note AS note
mapper.update: UPDATE fnd30_opr SET fnd30_demand_date = #{r.demandDate}, fnd30_item_nm = #{r.itemName}, fnd30_lead_manager = #{r.leadManager}, fnd30_demand_period = #{r.demandPeriod}, fnd30_market = #{r.market}, fnd30_price_bracket = #{r.priceBracket}, fnd30_price = #{r.price}, fnd30_price_accept_yn = CASE WHEN #{r.priceAcceptYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END, fnd30_lock_period = #{r.lockPeriod}, fnd30_note = #{r.note}, fnd30_cancel_yn = CASE WHEN #{r.cancelYn} THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END WHERE fnd30_opr_id = #{oprId} AND fnd30_company_id = #{companyId}
